note: This pointer stands in for the 9.7 MiB sweep.json, which is bulk run data and is hosted in the public Quilt package rather than in git. Only analysis.py needs it: run the fetch command above to place the real file at experiments/sfp_representation/009_artifacts/sweep.json before running 'analysis.py --check'. Every other module's --check path is self-contained and needs nothing fetched. Regenerating it locally instead of fetching costs about 1843 s of GPU-free CPU time via 'run_sweep.py'.

quilt_hash.note: The Quilt manifest hashes entries with its own chunked scheme, so this value is expected to differ from the plain-file 'sha256' above. It is not a mismatch. Use 'sha256' to verify a fetched file with shasum.
